$comment: Machine-readable status for the scenarios in NEGATIVE_TEST_CATALOGUE.md (SECB-WP-FWK-042, corrected under the operator's review of 2026-08-11 §P1). This file exists to fix a defect in the first version: two tests asserted a HOLE as current behaviour, so closing the hole would have turned CI red. Tests now compare observed behaviour against the status DECLARED here, so a fix requires flipping the status and CI stays meaningful either way. Statuses are observations; remediation obligations are recorded, not enforced -- enforcement is external, per FR-08.

status_vocabulary.COVERED: a control blocks the scenario, and a named test proves it
status_vocabulary.GAP_REPRODUCED: the scenario succeeds today; a characterization fixture demonstrates it. NOT a conformance requirement -- flip to CONTROL_FIXED when a control lands
status_vocabulary.CONTROL_FIXED: a control now blocks it; the characterization fixture is retired and a desired-behaviour regression replaces it
status_vocabulary.DORMANT_ABSENT_CAPABILITY: the scenario cannot occur because the capability it attacks does not exist. Carries an activation_predicate so the test wakes when the capability appears
status_vocabulary.$comment: Replaces NOT_APPLICABLE, which read as 'considered and dismissed'. Dormant is the honest word: absent, not irrelevant.
status_vocabulary.GAP_UNCHARACTERIZED: the scenario is named and believed to succeed today, but no fixture demonstrates it. Weaker evidence than GAP_REPRODUCED and recorded as such rather than blurred into it
status_vocabulary.CONTROL_FIXED_CONDITIONAL: a control blocks the scenario, but only when the caller supplies the input it needs. Weaker than CONTROL_FIXED and recorded as its own status rather than rounded up to it: a caller that omits the input gets the pre-fix behaviour, and the verdict line says so

FPSA.note_target_grew: target 15 -> 16: FPSA-02-SEQ is a new scenario created by closing FPSA-02, not a scenario that was overlooked. A fix that reveals a narrower residual should enlarge the denominator, not hide inside the old one

coverage.note: Dormant scenarios are not failures while the capability is absent, and they are not coverage of the target state either. Both fractions are published so neither reading can stand alone. Updated by SECB-WP-FWK-044: FPSA-03 moved from gap to covered, so FPSA is 5 of 11 applicable and 5 of 15 target.

corrections.what: BACP covered was published as 2 and is 1. SECB-WP-FWK-042 counted BACP-17's TWO TESTS as two scenarios, so the published figures were 40.0% of applicable and 11.1% of target where the truth is 25.0% and 5.6% -- wrong in the flattering direction. Found by test_the_catalogue_agrees_with_the_machine_readable_status, written in this work package for a different drift and catching this one on its first run.
corrections.also: dormant was 13 and is 14: BACP-18 was omitted from the count.

AMS.note: Both scenarios are GAP_REPRODUCED and both were demonstrated by a real merge rather than a fixture written in advance -- #111 and #120. Coverage is 0 of 2 and saying so is the point: the standard naming these defects was written after they shipped. Each scenario carries flip_requires, so neither can be closed by adding a file: AMS-01 needs the lattice join computed, AMS-02 needs six enforcement behaviours proven.

scenarios.title: Split a change into several tickets to evade a class
scenarios.observed: SECB-WP-FWK-046: the cap applies to total + FAMILY_LINES, so 550 lines with a 550-line sibling escalates where it used to auto-approve. CONDITIONAL because FAMILY_LINES is caller-supplied -- NFR-12 keeps the classifier off the network, so CI computes the aggregate. A caller that omits it gets the old behaviour, and the verdict line reports 'no concurrent family reported' so the omission is visible

remediation.status: CLOSED for concurrent splitting by SECB-WP-FWK-046

scenarios.title: Hide authority-shaped data in a new configuration file
scenarios.observed: config/ is governance implementation since SECB-WP-FWK-044; a new file under it returns AGENT_BALLOT_REQUIRED, and the two named files remain CONSTITUTIONAL_REQUIRED
scenarios.found_by: doing it -- SECB-WP-FWK-041 landed config/identifier_taxonomy.json at G0 under this rule

remediation.what_changed: config/ removed from auto_paths and added to governance_implementation_paths; removed from both rather than only added, so a future removal from the governance list yields 'outside the delegated envelope' rather than silently restoring G0
remediation.authority: G4 (envelope) — merged by the constitutional authority
remediation.retroactive_effect: config/identifier_taxonomy.json, landed at G0 by FWK-041 under the old rule, now classifies AGENT_BALLOT_REQUIRED

scenarios.title: Reduce an approval threshold or quorum
Change the classifier so your own change scores lower
Change a protected path so your file stops being protected
Disable the audit logger or edit evidence after a verdict
scenarios.partial: covers deletion and the CI half; editing evidence in place without deleting it is not covered

scenarios.title: Squash merge falsifies a tested-head ancestry check
Proposer and auditor use one identity
scenarios.when_active_requires: distinct workload identity, distinct signing key, no producer/auditor role overlap, no shared delegation chain below the required boundary

scenarios.title: Cost or concurrency exceeds its cap mid-execution
A rollback script that cannot restore the baseline
Several agents share a signer but are counted as a quorum

Crash after an external effect · replayed webhook · lease expiry mid-write · takeover without inspection · tampered policy bundle · borrowed auditor credential · injected tool response · kill signal mid-call · partial compensation · lagging cost telemetry · learning candidate edits its evaluator · claimed-complete with a failing postcondition · rollback to an incompatible schema
scenarios.absent_capability: durable workflow, external effects, leases, signed bundles, a second identity, a learning pipeline
scenarios.activation_predicate: any external effect is executed, i.e. E4 evidence ceases to be none

scenarios.title: Rename a request to evade the duplicate detector
scenarios.observed: No duplicate detector exists; FWK-038 measured the need and deferred the machinery with a trigger

scenarios.title: Add an integration without declaring it
scenarios.observed: No expansion manifest and no declared write_set

scenarios.title: Add an exception with no expiry
scenarios.observed: No exception registry; the two live exceptions carry expiry by hand

scenarios.title: Keep a plugin or workflow past its trial expiry
scenarios.observed: No retirement contract; FWK-039 measured one confirmed orphan, src/secb_router/, 669 SLOC with no runtime consumer

scenarios.title: Add a policy that contradicts a canonical one
scenarios.observed: The Specification Conflict Protocol is applied by reading; four conflict records exist, all raised by hand

scenarios.title: Base branch changes after CI passes
scenarios.observed: SECB-WP-FWK-047 reports base staleness with the distance, so a verdict computed against a moved base says so. CONDITIONAL because it reports rather than blocks: with a queue open, every merge staleifies the rest, so a blocking gate would make the queue undrainable. Compensating control is the human merge gate; trigger to make it blocking is a merge queue (deferred, §D4, behind 403 branch protection)

scenarios.title: A status check arrives from an unexpected source
scenarios.observed: Requires rulesets to pin the expected app; the API returns 403 Upgrade to GitHub Pro. Unfixable on this plan

scenarios.title: Sub-work items created to evade a budget
scenarios.observed: SECB-WP-FWK-046: the cap applies to total + FAMILY_LINES, so 550 lines with a 550-line sibling escalates where it used to auto-approve. CONDITIONAL because FAMILY_LINES is caller-supplied -- NFR-12 keeps the classifier off the network, so CI computes the aggregate. A caller that omits it gets the old behaviour, and the verdict line reports 'no concurrent family reported' so the omission is visible

remediation.status: CLOSED for concurrent splitting by SECB-WP-FWK-046

scenarios.title: Split sequentially: merge one half, then open the other
scenarios.observed: Each half is judged alone because the family is computed over OPEN pull requests only. Closing it needs a lookback over merged work, and a window wide enough to matter would fold most of this repository into one family -- the RAAF profile suggests 30 days, which would make the cap unreachable. Recorded rather than claimed, per SECB-WP-FWK-046

scenarios.title: A decision-bearing artifact under an auto_path receives G0 because of its path
scenarios.observed: SECB-WP-FWK-063: the classifier grades by path, so a stage-gate verdict living under docs/ returns AUTO_APPROVED - G0. Demonstrated live on PR #111, whose diff was a D2 MATERIAL verdict and whose rendered verdict was G0 auto-merge. Ruled a downgrade by the operator 2026-08-14; K-09 d=2.
scenarios.not_a_conformance_requirement: The fixture asserts the CURRENT behaviour against a declared status. When WP-02's semantic classifier lands, effective_class = max(...) raises this to NS2 and the declared status flips to CONTROL_FIXED. The fixture must not redden CI on the fix.
scenarios.named_fix: WP-02 semantic classifier -- required_authority as a LATTICE JOIN of authority requirements, not a numeric max over incommensurable classification domains
flip_requires: a decision-bearing artifact under an auto_path no longer satisfies G0

scenarios.title: An authoritative record is made effective by self-merge with no head-bound ratification receipt
scenarios.observed: SECB-WP-FWK-063: nothing in the merge path requires a ratification receipt bound to the exact head, so an executor can make an authoritative record operative by self-merging it. Demonstrated live on PR #120, which stamped stage 2 EFFECTIVE and recorded C-5/C-6/C-7. Ruled a downgrade on the principle that transcription authority is not effectuation authority.
scenarios.not_a_conformance_requirement: Asserts that NOTHING in the tree consumes a ratification receipt -- no script, no workflow, no gate. Corrected under review: the first version asserted that no receipt ARTIFACT existed, which would have let a filename flip the status. Receipt schema exists != receipt is required; receipt is required != enforcement cannot be bypassed.
scenarios.named_fix: WP-04 EBTA evaluator (eligibility conjunction) + WP-05 identity separation for the receipt's independence field
scenarios.blocked_by: C-7 -- the receipt requires actor.github_user_id independent of the executor and decision: APPROVE, and GitHub refuses an approving review from a PR's own author. Unobtainable under one account, so PR #113 is STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED rather than awaiting ratification.
flip_requires: valid independent receipt -> authority conjunct PASS

artifact_classification.reason: the artifact passed the four gates whose incompleteness it measures. Gate-green means the recorded coverage still holds; it does not mean autonomy is complete, and the two must never be quoted as one result.

rows_are_complete: Every scenario has a row except the thirteen collapsed into BACP-RUNTIME-GROUP. A sparse record cannot be the source of truth: before SECB-WP-FWK-044 the coverage block and the rows disagreed and no test compared them.
notes: Corrected in SECB-WP-FWK-044: FPSA-03 closed; eight missing scenario rows added so the record is complete rather than sparse; BACP's covered count corrected from 2 to 1 and its percentages from 40.0/11.1 to 25.0/5.6.
